info.title: Novus Node RPC
info.description: HTTP API for querying a Novus node and submitting signed transactions. Coin amounts in JSON responses are atomic units; wallet CLI amounts are coin units with up to 6 decimal places. One whole coin equals 1,000,000 atomic units.

200.description: Node status, chain height, supply, race block rewards, tax vault balances, and Chip War epoch state

get.summary: Get transaction fees, tax, exchange, reward, stake, and difficulty policies

200.description: Only Novus transfers pay a size-based fee in Novus to the including block miner. All other transactions have no relay fee. Difficulty uses LWMA over 120 blocks and retargets every block, with a maximum solve-time sample of six target intervals and a 16x starting-difficulty cap. Chip War tax adjustments for the sender's race apply to every taxable transaction type: base rates are 1% for race-currency transfers and Gold transfers, 3% for race currency to Gold conversion, 1% for Gold to race currency conversion, and 5% for Gold to Novus conversion. Loss and failure both add 1 point to a shared cumulative modifier, capped at +3 points; a win subtracts 1 point down to a zero modifier. Maximum rates are 4%, 6%, 4%, and 8%, respectively. Taxes use the source currency and are held in the originating race's vault, including Gold taxes; only miners of that race can claim them. Gold transfers are restricted to accounts of the sender's race. Novus transfers are global and tax-exempt. Gold converts one way at 1,000 Gold to 1 Novus; reverse conversion is unavailable.

post.summary: Submit a signed canonical Borsh transaction
post.description: Transactions sign an explicit tax amount in the source currency. The node recalculates the tax from current consensus rules and rejects stale or incorrect values. Wallet commands build, sign, and submit transactions here, including `wallet stake heartbeat` for one node-participation attestation per epoch. To submit a transaction created offline, decode its hex to bytes and POST those bytes with Content-Type application/octet-stream.

200.description: Transaction accepted into the node mempool

get.summary: Get account balance and next usable nonce
get.description: Returns confirmed balances in atomic units. The nonce advances past contiguous transactions already in the mempool.

get.summary: Get the race assigned to an account

200.description: Race assignment, or null if the account has not registered

get.summary: Get stake, war contribution, and rank for an account

200.description: Wallet stake status, current-epoch participation, cumulative non-transferable contribution points, and persistent race-specific rank. Stakers participate through active stake; a wallet-operated node can submit one signed heartbeat per epoch without finding a block.

get.summary: Get protocol tax balances for all race vaults
get.description: Shows unclaimed tax balances grouped by the race that originated the tax and by currency. Amounts are atomic units. Only miners from the originating race can claim that race's vault.

200.description: All race tax vault balances and totals by currency

get.summary: Get unclaimed tax balances for one race

200.description: The selected race's unclaimed tax balances by currency

get.summary: Get current Chip War epoch and race participation
get.description: Returns active staker counts and current-epoch participant counts for every race, epoch block counts, tax and exchange modifiers, and the race-specific rank labels. Each unique wallet that stakes during an epoch or submits a signed node heartbeat earns one cumulative contribution point at settlement.

200.description: Current war status for all races

get.summary: Get Chip War status for one race

200.description: Current war status and participant count for the selected race
